create_graph: create a gtn Graph object to build a finite state transducer for pattern recognition
add_node_to_graph: add a node to the graph with optional start and final state flags
add_arc_to_graph: add an arc between two nodes in the graph with a symbol label
draw_graph_to_pdf: draw and export a gtn graph to a PDF file with input and output symbol mappings
union_graphs: compute the union of multiple gtn graphs into a single combined graph
